stops.note: to bring into agreement, from ad- (to) and cor (heart)
German musicians took the term from French 'accord', harmony
coined by Cyrill Demian for the newly invented bellows instrument built around chords
Cyrill Demian patented the 'Accordion' in Vienna in 1829, named for its ability to play whole chords

current_meaning: a portable musical instrument played by pressing keys or buttons while working a bellows
